features: AI: face / motion detection (varies by listing)
XMEye (Xiongmai) P2P app; ONVIF / RTSP capable
motion detection with FTP / email photo + local alarm
release_notes: ASECAM-branded white-label 8MP PoE dome built on the Xiongmai (XMEye, www.xmeye.net) OEM platform. Sold on AliExpress / asecam.net under generic listing names ("8MP IP Camera", "Face Detection IP Camera") with minor marketing variants — face- vs motion-detection AI and IR 10-30m / 30-50m — on what is the same hardware; captured here as one representative entry. No official manufacturer datasheet exists; specs are taken verbatim from the retailer listings (megapixel WxH, IK rating, and exact IR distance are not published, so are omitted rather than guessed).

frigate.notes: Xiongmai/XMEye OEM — RTSP path is firmware-dependent and UNVERIFIED for this unit. The legacy path shown (main stream=0 / sub stream=1) is the classic Xiongmai form; newer firmware uses '/live/main' and '/live/sub' on port 80 instead (see Hiseeu, same OEM). Confirm the exact path via ONVIF auto-discovery or the camera's own docs before relying on it.

home_assistant.notes: Xiongmai/XMEye OEM — use the ONVIF integration (default port 80). The XMEye cloud app is proprietary; ONVIF/RTSP is the local path.

blue_iris.notes: Use the generic ONVIF/RTSP profile (Xiongmai OEM).
